description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!   
At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.   
 Job Description: 
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented full-stack Software Engineer to join our team! In this role you will get to support the development and integration of diverse and challenging systems that are constantly evolving with the technology landscape.  

 You will be an integral part of our team solving challenging mission-focused problems to meet customer needs. You will participate on an Agile team to develop well-designed, testable, and efficient code. You will collaborate with team members in person or remotely, ask smart questions, take risks, and champion innovative solutions. 

 What You’ll be Doing:  

 Work within an established software architecture and collaborating with senior engineers, you will design, develop, and maintain full-stack software applications using Python, React, and TypeScript to integrate, process, and correlate structured and unstructured intelligence data through APIs and backend services. 
 Develop interactive dashboards, custom interfaces, and data visualization capabilities to support SIGINT analysis, vulnerability research, and collaborative mission workflows, while enabling integration with external AI platforms. 
 Collaborate with mission stakeholders and engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions through Agile development practices, automated testing, and continuous integration. 
 
 What Required Skills You'll Bring: 

 Bachelor's Degree Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field. Additional years of experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
 5+ years of related professional experience
 Active Secret clearance is required
 Experience developing full-stack applications using Java, C++, and React/TypeScript 
 Experience developing backend services and RESTful APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or equivalent technologies 
 Experience developing interactive user interfaces and dashboards using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks 
 Experience working with structured data formats such as JSON and XML and relational databases such as PostgreSQL 
 Familiarity with data ingestion, parsing, transformation, and integration across multiple data sources 
 Experience using Git, software debugging tools, and automated testing frameworks. 
 Familiarity with Linux development environments and containerization technologies such as Docker 
 Understanding of software engineering principles, secure coding practices, and Agile development methodologies 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary technical teams 
 
 What Desired Skills You'll Bring: 

 Experience developing software supporting SIGINT, intelligence analysis, cyber operations, or other national security missions 
 Familiarity with reverse engineering, vulnerability research, or cyber threat analysis. 
 Familiarity with data fusion, entity resolution, record correlation, or graph-based data relationships 
 Familiarity with graph databases, NoSQL databases, or modern data processing frameworks. 
 Experience developing data visualization interfaces using libraries such as D3.js, Plotly, or equivalent technologies 
 Experience working with unstructured data, including text extraction, metadata enrichment, and automated data classification 
 Familiarity with AI/ML technologies, Large Language Models (LLMs), and integration with external AI platforms through APIs 
 Experience with Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and automated software deployment 
 Familiarity with cybersecurity best practices, authentication, authorization, and secure API development 
 
 Security Clearance Requirement: 
An active Top Secret security clearance is required for this position.​ 
 
This position is part of our Federal Solutions team. 
 
The Federal Solutions segment delivers resources to our US government customers that ensure the success of missions around the globe. Our intelligent employees drive the state of the art as they provide services and solutions in the areas of defense, security, intelligence, infrastructure, and environmental. We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Throughout the company, our people are anticipating what’s next to deliver the solutions our customers need now. 
 
Salary Range: $103,500.00 - $181,100.00 
 
 
 
We value our employees and want our employees to take care of their overall wellbeing, which is why we offer best-in-class benefits such as medical, dental, vision, paid time off, 401(k), life insurance, flexible work schedules, and holidays to fit your busy lifestyle! 
 
 
 
This position will be posted for a minimum of 3 days and will continue to be posted for an average of 30 days until a qualified applicant is selected or the position has been cancelled. 
 
Parsons is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. 
 
We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY! 
 Parsons is aware of fraudulent recruitment practices. To learn more about recruitment fraud and how to report it, please refer to   https://www.parsons.com/fraudulent-recruitment/ .
